differential.name: Acute non‑ST segment elevation myocardial infarction
differential.rationale: Classic presentation in an elderly hypertensive, obese patient with prior MI and elevated cardiovascular risk.

differential.name: Unstable angina
differential.rationale: Similar risk profile; chest discomfort without definitive biomarker rise can mimic NSTEMI.

differential.name: Pulmonary embolism
differential.rationale: Acute dyspnea or pleuritic chest pain can occur in older, sedentary patients with recent immobilization or stress.

differential.name: Aortic dissection
differential.rationale: Severe, tearing chest pain in a hypertensive elder warrants consideration despite lower prevalence.

differential.name: Gastroesophageal reflux disease
differential.rationale: Non‑cardiac chest pain common in older adults; may coexist with cardiac disease and mimic ischemic symptoms.
